environment.description: Same OAuth provider code deployed behind an internal ALB with a Cognito-integrated authorizer. The critical control: an AWS CloudFront distribution sits in front with a Lambda@Edge origin-request function that performs strict URI canonicalization and normalization (decoding percent-encoding, resolving path traversal sequences, removing dot-segments per RFC 3986 Section 5.2.4) BEFORE the request reaches the application. Additionally, the Terraform Cloud workspace has a Vault dynamic secrets engine configured with a lease_ttl of 60s and max_lease_ttl of 60s for the OAuth client_secret, meaning any intercepted credential from a redirected auth code flow becomes invalid before it can be exchanged at /token. The Vault lease revocation is synchronous with rotation — the previous secret is explicitly revoked (not just expired) via Vault's sys/leases/revoke endpoint called by a nomad periodic job every 58 seconds.

config.cloudfront: Lambda@Edge origin-request with RFC3986 URI normalization

vault_dynamic_secrets.revocation: synchronous via nomad periodic job at 58s intervals

config.network: VPC endpoints only, no direct internet egress from Fargate tasks
config.dns: private hosted zone, not resolvable externally
